{{Quote|This debate is pointless unless you can get inside that cave. You'll need one of the leaders' access keys.|Moorint tells the Padawan how to access the cache|<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />}}
A '''Warmaster''' of the [[Flesh Raider]] [[Species/Legends|species]] guarded the [[Upper Hollows]], a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] system in the [[Tythos Ridge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], during the [[Flesh Raider uprising|conflict]] between the Flesh Raiders and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. A Flesh Raider with [[Color/Legends|gray]] skin, red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and white markings across the individual's body, the Warmaster wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and carried a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] in battle against the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] villagers of the nearby [[Kalikori village]]. The Flesh Raider rose to the rank of [[Warmaster (Flesh Raider)|warmaster]]<ref name="High-Tech Savages" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> when the individual was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Hero of Tython|young Padawan]] who had been [[Raid on the Flesh Raider weapons cache|sent to steal]] weapons from the Flesh Raiders for the people of Kalikori Village. After defeating the Flesh Raider, the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] used the Warmaster's key to access one of the natives' weapons caches.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Warmaster appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. The Flesh Raider is the target of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] mission "High-Tech Savages," in which the villager [[Moorint]] instructs the player to take the Warmaster's key and access a weapons cache.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />
